in_hindi.name: नाथुराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाथु (नाथ, नाथुजी = Lord) + राम (गाव, गावन = Cows)

in_marathi.name: Nathuram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nathuram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nathu means 'Lord' and Ram means 'Earth'. The name Nathuram signifies the one who is the Lord of the Earth and is full of courage and strength.

in_bengali.name: Nathuram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nathuram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nathu means 'Lord' and Ram means 'Earth'. The name Nathuram signifies the one who is the Lord of the Earth and is full of courage and strength.
